name: io.github.TinySuiteHQ/tinycontext
description: Token-light local memory with SQLite hybrid retrieval for MCP agents.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: MCP transport to serve: stdio (default), sse, or streamable-http.

environmentVariables.name: TINYCONTEXT_CONFIG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a context_config.json inside the container.

environmentVariables.name: TINYCONTEXT_MEMORY_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the TinyContext SQLite database.

environmentVariables.name: TINYCONTEXT_MODELS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory used for downloaded ONNX embedding bundles.
